location.site_description: Certain lands along County Highway B between 650th Avenue (Eagle Point Road) and 690th Avenue, directly east of Ellsworth Creamery; city materials describe approximately 320 acres, with a concept block plan also showing 708th Avenue.

status_as_of_cutoff: Local process / paused-tax-incentive posture. Menomonie adopted annexation and I-1 rezoning in August 2025, but the City later created an I-4 Data Center Industrial District, says no lands are currently zoned I-4, and says Balloonist would need to apply for I-4 rezoning if it decides to proceed. The August 3, 2026 council packet listed draft I-4 amendments for discussion only with no action intended. No final site plan approval, building permit, construction, certificate of occupancy, energization, or disclosed IT-load capacity was located.
evidence_grade: A- official city agenda/minutes/press releases plus state corporate registry; no permit/construction evidence located

actions.result_status: Official agenda/memorandum identifies Balloonist LLC, the CTH B lands, and the intended data-center use; it says the Plan Commission would vote on a recommendation. The cited agenda does not supply the final recommendation tally.
actions.evidence_note: Planning record identifies intended use without inferring approval.

actions.result_status: Official council minutes record adoption of Ordinance 2025-04 annexing lands along CTH B and establishing temporary Agricultural zoning.
actions.access_caveat: The cited August 18 minutes approve the August 4 minutes and reproduce the August 4 action; no data-center building authorization follows.
actions.evidence_note: Annexation/temporary zoning, separate from final industrial zoning and permits.

actions.result_status: City press release says Council adopted Ordinance 2025-05 rezoning the CTH B lands from Agriculture to I-1 for a potential data-center development and expressly says adoption does not guarantee a data center will be developed.
actions.access_caveat: Official city press release; it is a summary, while the result/tally is explicit in the release.
actions.evidence_note: Zoning action with explicit non-guarantee preserved.

actions.result_status: Official mayoral press release says the mayor instructed the city administrator to notify Balloonist LLC representatives that the City would not negotiate a development agreement or establish a tax increment district at that time to support a data center.
actions.access_caveat: Mayor statement; it pauses city development-agreement/TID negotiations, not the private project or land ownership.
actions.evidence_note: Shows official pause in city incentive/agreement posture without treating the project as legally terminated.

actions.action_type: creation of I-4 Data Center Industrial District
actions.result_status: Official council minutes record unanimous roll-call adoption of Ordinance 2026-01, amending Title 10 with respect to warehousing definition, data-center definition, and creation of the I-4 Data Center Industrial District.
actions.access_caveat: City zoning text action; it does not itself rezone the Red Cedar/Balloonist lands to I-4 or approve construction.
actions.evidence_note: Material change from the August 2025 I-1 posture; data centers now have a distinct zoning district.

actions.result_status: Official mayoral press release says I-4 zoning for data centers was approved in January 2026; the City was preparing additional I-4 regulations for light/noise, water use, equipment setbacks, landscaping, reclamation, and related topics; Balloonist LLC would have the legal opportunity to apply for I-4 rezoning only after completion/adoption of the ordinance amendment, should it decide to do so.
actions.access_caveat: Mayor statement about ordinance process; no final rezoning application or construction approval is stated.
actions.evidence_note: Confirms continued local-process status and that tax-incentive pause did not stop the private project.

actions.result_status: Official council agenda listed 'Draft Ordinance amending Data Center Industrial (I-4) District Zoning' as discussion only with no action. The council packet staff memorandum says a second draft would be prepared later, no action or introduction was intended, no lands are currently zoned I-4, and any I-4 district modification or rezoning would require public notice, public hearing, and City Council action.
actions.access_caveat: Agenda and packet were available; official minutes for the August 3 meeting were not located during this refresh.
actions.evidence_note: Supports no-current-I-4-zoning and no-action status as of the packet date.

capacity_notes: No disclosed IT-load MW was located. Official city FAQ states an approximate $1.6 billion planned investment; city press release estimated average municipal water/wastewater demand at 75,000 gallons per day for a proposed closed-loop cooling system.
owner: Balloonist LLC (project/developer entity; ultimate operator/end user not publicly disclosed in located official sources)

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; seed merged only with explicit evidence

history.previous_value: Annexation and I-1 rezoning were adopted, but the City says adoption does not guarantee a data center; no final site plan, building permit, construction, CO, or energization was located. Later public materials preserve continued uncertainty.
history.reason: Refresh found newer official city materials showing I-4 data-center zoning process, paused TID/development-agreement negotiations, no current I-4-zoned land, and no action on the August 3, 2026 draft amendment.
Official city materials identify Balloonist LLC as applicant/project entity; WI DFI registry confirms Balloonist LLC is a registered foreign LLC. Ultimate operator remains undisclosed.
